newsitem.title: UK: British Gas crawls up, broker repeats "buy'.
newsitem.headline: British Gas crawls up, broker repeats "buy'.

text.p: Shares in British Gas staged a modest recovery on Tuesday as brokers SBC Warburg repeated their positive stance on the stock and news emerged of an EU clearance of a joint venture deal.
By 0958 GMT the shares were up 3p at 184p, bouncing back from Monday's near three-month low in the share price. Around three and a half million shares were traded.
"The falls yesterday were massively overdone," said Matthew Warburton, analyst at SBC Warburg.
The analyst repeated his short term share price target of 210p for the stock.
"The shares are good value at these levels," Warburton said.
Confirmation that EU clearance had been given to a proposed joint venture with Group 4 Utility Services also helped sentiment.
"It's another small positive, outsourcing meter reading and getting the cost base better positioned," the analyst said.
The shares had slumped in response to talk of cheap Norwegian gas imports and concern that Ofgas may widen an MMC inquiry into British Gas' operations.
